dynamiclighting.screen.title: Dynamic Lighting
dynamiclighting.option.mode.tooltip: Master switch and update rate. Fastest is the lightest on performance, Fancy follows moving lights most smoothly.
dynamiclighting.option.range.tooltip: How far dynamic light reaches. Short fades out quickly. Long reaches as far as a placed light source, but updates more chunks.
dynamiclighting.option.self_light.toolti: The items you hold and wear light up your surroundings.
dynamiclighting.option.entity_lights.too: Other players, mobs and dropped items give off light.
dynamiclighting.option.water_sensitive.t: Torches and other fire-based lights go out under water.
Living entities with the glowing effect give off light.
dynamiclighting.option.creeper.tooltip: Light of a creeper that is about to explode. Simple shines steadily, Fancy grows brighter as the creeper swells.
dynamiclighting.option.tnt.tooltip: Light of lit TNT. Simple shines steadily, Fancy grows brighter as the fuse burns down.
